children: Railgun launches PQ-RAILGUN on 22 November 2026. The release brings post-quantum protection to the privacy features that Railgun provides to users on Ethereum.

The change strengthens the core product behind RAIL by making its privacy protections more resistant to threats from quantum computers. Railgun keeps the protection decentralized, so the added resistance does not require putting a central operator in charge of it.
Post-quantum security for privacy on Ethereum doesn't require sacrificing decentralization. It's here today.

title: Railgun: PQ-RAILGUN launches on Ethereum - 22 Nov 2026
